observations: Predicted five roads. Built A–C cost1, B–C cost2, D–E cost3; A–B cost4 was skipped while components still separate.
B–D cost5 joined both groups. Test-rest finished four built, four skipped, total11.
Screenshot showed A/B/C same color, D/E another, built edges bright and next connecting edge highlighted. Reveal explicitly contrasted skipped cost4 and accepted cost5 through existing C path.
